blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Industrial property for sale and lease in Cloverdale: warehouses, industrial buildings, shop condos and industrial strata units listed on the MLS®. Space for lease is included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: The Cloverdale industrial area covers 700 acres in three parts: Cloverdale East (333 acres), Cloverdale South (268 acres) and Cloverdale North (98 acres). It is home to 731 companies. ([City of Surrey, Cloverdale Industrial Area](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/CloverdaleIndustrialArea.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

It sits where Highway 15, the route to Highway 1 and the Pacific border crossing, meets Highway 10, an east–west trucking route. The 72 Avenue improvements and extension started in May 2025. ([City of Surrey, Cloverdale Industrial Area](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/CloverdaleIndustrialArea.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 19 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were industrial properties, against 81 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only Cloverdale.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Surrey submarket (45.1M sq ft) was 4.2% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $19.66 per sq ft net plus $6.95 in additional rent, with 1,628,917 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey zones that allow industrial uses

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside Cloverdale. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.
